IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleWhen') BEGIN create table [security].[RuleWhen] ( Id bigint not null, [Position] int not null, CheckType char(1) not null, -- F, R, A FieldTypeId int sparse, IntersectTypeId int sparse, [Operator] int not null, [Value] nvarchar(500) sparse, AssetId bigint sparse,
constraint [PK_Security_RuleWhen] primary key clustered ( Id, [Position] asc ) ) END
